blocks.text: NUSEIRAT, Palestinian Territories — The Israeli military said it launched an operation on Wednesday in a Hamas-controlled area of central Gaza, where an AFP journalist saw Israeli tanks positioning themselves east of the Nuseirat refugee camp. The rare ground incursion came after inconclusive Israeli elections, with opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot trying to form a government without caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has built his political brand on pledging to ensure Israel’s security.
